missionPremise: 48021:8723767's 'More facts' setback X-ray on smartsite.cloud prints a raw developer string ('edge 1: R32 35.02831192164916ft != expected 5ft for role side; edge 4: R32 53.60964475445567ft != expected 25ft for role rear'). P-154/A-148 already ratified that a genuine setback-source conflict must be disclosed; this row is about the RENDERING and about whether the underlying disagreement is real, not about removing the disclosure.
correctionToEarlierPlannerClaim: The dispatch itself flags a prior seat's wrong inference that this string was panel-generated because it is absent from get_smart_site's depth-node JSON payload. Confirmed independently: it is genuinely absent from that payload (verified live, mcp__claude_ai_Smart_Site__get_smart_site depth=node on 48021:8723767) -- but the panel does NOT read that payload for this string. It reads its own live-derive POST endpoint (see sourceTrace below), a completely different server route.

whereRIs32FoundAndWhatItIs.method: gh search code across the whole empressaioemail-tech org for the literal token 'R32' after zero hits inside legacy-design-tools and hauska-map's checked-out source (both repos read in full for every plausible composer: buildableEnvelope/*, InspectCard.tsx, baked-facets.ts, live-envelope-augment.ts, r1BriefCompose.ts, brokerageNodeFacets.ts -- none contain the literal string).
whereRIs32FoundAndWhatItIs.found: hauska-engine (NOT legacy-design-tools, NOT hauska-map) packages/engine-core/src/depth-warm/cert-equivalent-gates.ts, function verifyR32PerEdgeInset -- 'R32' is that internal mechanical-certification gate's own name (WDLL 27c/R33 program, 'R32 per-edge inset remeasure -- shared by warm promote and mechanical cert'). Its failure-reason strings are literally: `edge ${i}: R32 ${r32}ft != expected ${expected}ft for role ${role}`. This is developer/ops shop talk from hauska-engine's own depth-warm certification harness -- never written to be read by a customer.
whereRIs32FoundAndWhatItIs.howItReachesACustomer: hauska-engine packages/engine-core/src/depth-warm/honest-decline-promote.ts, buildHonestVerifyDeclineAtom(): `declineReason = input.verifyReasons.slice(0, 3).join('; ') || 'Mechanical warm verify failed -- honest decline.'`. This raw joined diagnostic is written into the persisted envelope atom's outcome.reason / absence.reason / (legacy) warmVerifyDecline -- fields the whole platform's honest-absence contract treats as customer-safe prose. legacy-design-tools fetches it verbatim via artifacts/api-server/src/lib/buildableEnvelope/fetchPropertyAtomChain.ts (GET {retrieval-api}/property-nodes/{id}/atom-chain, field buildableEnvelope.outcome.reason) and reconcileAtomEnvelope.ts's reconcileWithAtomEnvelope() interpolates it RAW into the served disclosure/emptyReason when atomOutcome.kind === 'no-buildable-area': `No buildable area: ${reason} (property atom chain, engine source of truth).`

whichSourceIsCorrectAndHow.engineDeclineTimeExpected: 5ft side / 25ft rear -- matches the EXACT stale numeric-shortcut-column values A-148 already established as the OLD, unrefreshed GIS 'One Click card' shortcut columns for this district (the same shape the P-154 wave-6 test fixture (r1BriefCompose.test.ts CONFLICT.numeric) hard-codes: front 25/side 5/rear 25). The R-1 ruling (most-current-source-wins, ratified 2026-09-11, _decisions/2026-09-11_setback_source_most_current_wins.md) already settled that the codified ordinance table wins here.
whichSourceIsCorrectAndHow.conclusion: The SERVED numbers (10/30) are correct per already-ratified canon. The engine's cert-time 'expected' values (5/25) are stale -- they predate either the R-1 fix or a re-run of this parcel's certification against the current table. This is not a new judgment call; it is applying an existing ruling to a fact the raw string obscured instead of naming.
whichSourceIsCorrectAndHow.additionalLiveConfirmation: Bastrop County's live ArcGIS Zoned_Parcels FeatureServer/83 (services7.arcgis.com/qOeXJdBtGknaCJC4) returns TWO overlapping rows for prop_id=8723767 today: ZoneTypeClass=7 (General Commercial, FrontSetback '20 feet', SideSetback '5 feet', RearSetback '20 feet') and ZoneTypeClass=3 (SF-1, 30/10/30/20). This is a genuine raw-source duplication in the county's own GIS layer, consistent with (though not numerically identical to) the stale-shortcut-column story A-148 already named. Not chased further -- it is evidence the underlying data ambiguity is real, not proof of the exact mechanism inside hauska-engine's own resolveInsetFeetForEdge.

theCoherenceDefectBehindTheStringDefect: reconcileAtomEnvelope.ts's no-buildable-area branch does not distinguish a genuine geometric finding (setbacks truly consume the lot) from a mechanical-verification FAILURE (the engine's own cert check could not confirm the geometry against ITS expectation). Both are written with emptyKind: 'consumed' and both clobber a live, correctly-computed derive.ts envelope. For 48021:8723767, derive.ts's own live pass (same request, same current setback table) produces a real drawable envelope -- the customer is not shown a wrong number instead of a right one; they are shown a FALSE 'zero buildable area, setbacks consume the lot' finding that overwrites a real one. Fixing only the string (rounding/renaming/hiding) would leave that false zero in place -- the falsifier the dispatch pre-registers against exactly this move.

briefVsOverlaySelfContradiction.confirmedLive: get_smart_site depth=node, 48021:8723767: brief.sections[setbacks-envelope].disposition = 'present' (frontFt 30/sideFt 10/rearFt 30/cornerFt 20) in the SAME response as draw.overlays[envelope] = {state: 'refused', reason: 'atom_path_pending', label: 'Buildable envelope not computed'}.
briefVsOverlaySelfContradiction.rootCause: artifacts/api-server/src/routes/brokerageNodeFacets.ts's baked-facets route UNCONDITIONALLY nulls facets.envelope (stripZombieEnvelopeFromFacets, WDLL 3.7 anti-zombie) for every node at bake time; the setbacks-envelope brief SECTION is populated separately from setbackRulesFact (a scalar fact, independent of the envelope atom). The get_smart_site MCP JSON is server-rendered once, so it can never benefit from the client-side live-derive augment (hauska-map's live-envelope-augment.ts) that the web panel uses to fill the polygon in for un-baked nodes -- the MCP surface has no equivalent server-side augment.
briefVsOverlaySelfContradiction.relationToRuling: The 2026-09-11 canon-preamble ruling 'ENVELOPE DRAWN, FIGURE REFUSED' already requires the draw block to draw the modelled envelope polygon (area/pct still refused) wherever a district and setback table exist -- which is true here (SF-1, ratified table). The current MCP draw overlay does not do this; it still refuses BOTH the polygon and the figure.
briefVsOverlaySelfContradiction.status: root-caused, NOT fixed this pass -- the fix is a real new capability (server-side envelope derivation inside the get_smart_site/facets composition path, not a rendering tweak) and touches a shared, actively-worked file (brokerageNodeFacets.ts) under real time pressure; scoped out to avoid a rushed change to a second live customer route in the same pass. See leave_behind.
